name: Vanguard Protocol
summary: Vanguard Protocol; Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 30 ft, it has disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before your next turn.  Vanguard; A creature affected by Vanguard Protocol also takes +1d4 rad or poison damage when you hit it.  Vanguard; Creatures damaged by your rad or poison effects cannot regain hit points until your next turn.  Vanguard; Your rad or poison effects impose disadvantage on the target’s next Strength or Constitution save.
descriptionMarkdown:
Vanguard Protocol; Once per turn, when you hit a creature within 30 ft, it has disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before your next turn.

Vanguard; A creature affected by Vanguard Protocol also takes +1d4 rad or poison damage when you hit it.

Vanguard; Creatures damaged by your rad or poison effects cannot regain hit points until your next turn.

Vanguard; Your rad or poison effects impose disadvantage on the target’s next Strength or Constitution save.
